pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - After School Club
pageCache.text:
After School Club
The After School Club at Canterbury Road Primary School is run by qualified members of staff; Mrs White and Miss Lewis and is run from The Willows building.
Our emphasis is to ensure that all children attending After School Club receive the care and security they need to enable them to feel safe and secure in a happy environment before starting the school day.
Children are collected by staff members from their classroom at the end of the school day and are taken up to The Willows building where parents can collect them at any time between 3:20 and 4:30pm*
The children at after school club are given a chance to complete any home tasks, AR or TTR quizzes and take part in adult -led activities such as gardening, baking and craft. There is also a secure outside area to play in during good weather.
We ask that all children are promptly collected by 4:30pm. Late collection may mean parents encurr an additional charge.
If you have an interest in your child attending The After School Club, please notify the school office and complete the application form. Once you have applied for After School Club and there is availability your child is able to attend on any day of the week regularly or as a one-off.
After School Club is open Monday – Friday during school term 3:20pm – 4:30pm
After School Club can be paid via the school online payment system School Money Site or via cash on the day or in advance.
* Children who are not registered for After School Club but not collected by 3:20pm without notice will be taken to After School Club and parents will be charged accordingly.

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Extra Curricular Clubs
pageCache.text:
Extra Curricular Clubs
Extra Curricular Clubs are Free to all children in Years 1- 6
They are allocated on a first come first served basis and there are a limited number of spaces per club.
Clubs for Term 5 are
Monday- Drawing Years 2 -6
Tuesday- Rapid Fire Cricket Years 1-2
Disney Appreciation Years 1-3
Wednesday- Art Club Years 1-2
Nature Explorers Years 4-6
Archaeology Club Years 1 -6
Dynamo Cricket Years 3- 6
Thursday Eco Club Years 1- 6
Netball Years 4, 5, 6

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - School Money, Teachers2Parents, Tapestry
pageCache.text:
School Money, Teachers2Parents, Tapestry
Canterbury Road Primary School uses Eduspot School Money and Teachers2Parents for online payments (except school dinners) and our school communication app. Parents can download the app here
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.teachers2parents.teachers2parents
Tapestry is the online learning journal for Early Years used in our Bumblebee class. Parents can download the app here
https://play.google.com/store/search?q=tapestry+online+learning+journal&c=apps
Tapestry is used in our Reception class to update parents and share your child's learning and daily activities. Information regarding Tapestry was provided in your starter pack when your child joined our reception class. Please speak to Mrs Martin if you do not have access to this. Photos, observations and letters will all be sent to parents via Tapestry.
https://tapestry.info/parents-carers.html
Teachers2Parents allows us to communicate quickly and effectively with our parents on a daily basis. In an effort to make our school eco-friendly as much information will be emailed to parents including new school menus, letters, newletters and information about school trips. Parents can download the app to receive messages or messages can be sent to their mobile via text. Parents can reply by text or email to this messages to quickly contact the school.
Please make sure school has up to date mobile contact number and email address for you. Some messages from Teachers2Parents may go into the junk folder, so please check regularly.
Schoolmoney is our effective online payment system for school trips and Breakfast Club. Parents can pay online in whole or part pay for school activities and have easy access to their spending and their child's account. Please talk to the school office if you are having trouble accessing schoolmoney.
The majority of payments at school are paid using school money. We remind parents that school dinners are provided by a catering company and have their own website for ordering and paying for meals.
https://chandcoparents.myschoolmealorders.com/login
Schoolmoney Parent Guide

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Wrap Around Care
pageCache.text:
Wrap Around Care
Breakfast Club is open Monday – Friday during the school term 7:45am – 8:40am
£3.50 a session per child
After School Club is open Monday – Friday during the school term 3:15 - 5pm
3:15 - 4:30pm £5 per session per child
3:15 - 5pm £7 per session per child
Breakfast stops being served at 8:30am to allow time to tidy up and get ready for the school day. Please make sure your child arrives before this time if you would like them to have breakfast. At After School Club children will be provided with a healthy snack.
Both breakfast and after school club can be paid via the school online payment system School Money Site or via cash on the day or in advance. Wrap around care at Canterbury Road can also be paid using your Tax free childcare account or UC payments. Visit https://www.childcarechoices.gov.uk/
From September 2026 we will be offering a Free Breakfast Club from 8:30 - 9am to offer a softer start and a healthy breakfast to all children in our school.
Childcare choices static 1 (1x1)

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Breakfast Club
pageCache.text:
Breakfast Club
The Breakfast Club at Canterbury Road Primary School is run by qualified members of staff; Miss Mitchell, Miss Finn, Miss Woodcock and held in The Willows building.
Our emphasis is to ensure that all children attending The Breakfast Club receive the care and security they need to enable them to feel safe and secure in a happy environment before starting the school day.
Children should be dropped off by parents/ carers at the door where they will be met by a member of staff.
The children are given a healthy choice of food and beverages including fruit a choice of breakfast cereals with or without milk, pastries breads, or toast with butter and a choice of spreads or conserves. Children are also offered a choice of drinks including milk, water and juice. All dietary requirements are taken into consideration.
Breakfast is served between 7:45 and 8:30am.
After breakfast the children clean their teeth and then have time to play. Children are encouraged to choose their own activities or join in with an adult-led activity. Some of the activities to choose from are board games, lego, dancing and arts and crafts. There is also a secure outside area to play in during good weather and we have use of the Astroturf for ball games.
At 8:40am the children are taken by The Breakfast Club staff into school and handed over to class teachers. All messages can then be passed between parents, Breakfast Club staff and class staff.
If you have an interest in your child attending The Breakfast Club, please notify the school office and complete the application form. Once you have applied for Breakfast Club and there is availability your child is able to attend on any day of the week regularly or as a one off.
Breakfast Club is open Monday – Friday during school term 7:45am – 8:40am
Breakfast stops being served at 8:30am to allow time to tidy up and get ready for the school day. Please make sure your child arrives before this time if you would like them to have breakfast. As our school is part of the National Breakfast Programme breakfast is offered for free meaning you only pay for childcare.
Breakfast Club can be paid via the school online payment system School Money Site or via cash on the day or in advance.

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Partnership With Other Schools
pageCache.text:
Partnership With Other Schools
Canterbury Road Primary School is part of the ‘Rural Swale Collaboration Group’ (RSCG), who, along with four other schools are working together, primarily, to raise standards and to enhance the teaching and learning across all schools.
The other schools in the collaboration group are Teynham, Eastling, Rodmersham, Bapchild and Tonge. These schools all work alongside one another is enabling us to:
We further aim to equip the children with life skills to be successful learners and to foster a love of learning.
Already there have been opportunities for children to develop their writing skills, for Numeracy and Literacy leaders to meet, for the Special Needs coordinators to share their expertise and for the Early Years practitioners to moderate the work of their children.
We are all very excited about the opportunities that both the staff and children are already benefiting from.
Enhance teaching and learning
Raise standards in Literacy and Numeracy
Share resources
listItems: Raise standards in Literacy and Numeracy

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Lunch Menus
pageCache.text:
Lunch Menus
Our lunches are cooked on site in our canteen/ kitchen area and provided by Nourish.
All lunches are bookable in advance online through the School Money Website or App and can be paid for daily, weekly, monthly or termly. Children can have a cooked school dinner every day or once in a while. Nourish regularly provides special lunches for events, including a School Christmas Lunch.
School dinners are available to order and pay for a term at a time.
For meal choices for this term menu below or obtain a copy from the school office.
All dietary requirements and allergies are catered for.
https://login.eduspot.co.uk/public/portal/parent/app=schoolmoney&source=website&version=20190314
to log in and order your child's school lunches.
https://www.nourishcontractcatering.co.uk/primary/

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Parent Area
pageCache.text:
Parent Area
Information for parents regarding courses and activities which might be helpful.

PTFA
Who are the PTFA? The current Chairperson is Mrs Karen Stratton (Year 4 parent) and the Treasurer is Mrs Becky Cumberland (Year 1 parent) along with a team of other valued members.
As a parent/ carer of a child attending Canterbury Road Primary School you are automatically a member of the PTFA. Your level of involvement is entirely your choice. Some parents attend the meetings where we organise events for the year, or help out at the school discos or run a stall at the fair. Whatever time you can offer contributes to the collective success of the PTFA. Everyone has something to offer and it is a great way to get to know the school and make new friends too.
What does the PTFA do? The PTFA plan and organise a number of exciting events throughout the year for the children’s enjoyment and fundraise to purchase additional resources for the school. Previous funds have enabled us to provide new benches in the playground and fund the Gardening Club. We have also made contributions towards new books and other items that help enrich the experience for children across the whole school.
What events do the PTFA organise? We organise a number of events including Summer and Christmas fairs, film nights, Mother’s/ Fathers Day activities and Christmas Gift Wrapping, end of term parties for Key Stage One, discos for Key Stage Two, quiz nights and more.
How do I find out more about joining the PTFA? You can find out more by attending our AGM in Autumn 2023 (date to be confirmed). Please request to join our Facebook page listed below to keep up to date with the latest news and activities.
Many thanks in advance for your support The PTFA Team
PTFA Summer Events

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - School Daily Routine
pageCache.text:
School Daily Routine
The school day starts at 8:45am when the gates are open and children are welcomed into the school.
Parents who need childcare before 8:45am can use Breakfast Club which is open 5 days a week, term time from 7:45am.
School finishes at 3:15pm. If your child attends a club these finish at 4pm unless specified.
8:45am- Start of the School Day
9am- All children should be in class ready for register
10:30am Break time (years 1, 2, 3)
10:50am Break time (years 4, 5, 6)
12 noon - Lunch time
1pm - Afternoon session starts - all children should be back in class for 1pm
2:50pm Assembly or Reading Buddies
3:15pm End of the School Day

Uniform
Canterbury Road’s uniform is designed to make children feel part of a community, feel pride in their school and enable parents to make easy and economical choices about school clothing. Most uniform items can be bought from several sources, including in supermarkets. Our school uniform with logo can be bought from My Clothing.com, Brigade or Forsters in East Street.
Our uniform consists of
* Grey or black trousers, skirt, shorts or pinafore dress
* White collared T shirt (with or without logo) or white shirt/blouse
* Royal blue cardigan, jumper or fleece with school logo
* Summer dress, shorts or playsuit in light blue checked fabric (with white top or checked top)
* Black flat shoes or black boots
*Summer sandals with straps (not flip-flop type) in black, white, grey or blue
* Black, white or grey socks or tights
* Headscarf or hijab in white, blue, grey or black.
* PE uniform consists of coloured t-shirt or polo shirt in house colours, black shorts or jogging bottoms, trainers or plimpsolls.

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Headteacher's Welcome
pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
Headteacher’s Welcome
I wish you a very warm welcome to the Canterbury Road Primary School website!
Thank you for your interest in Canterbury Road Primary School. We pride ourselves on being welcoming to all and on providing high quality teaching to pupils. We are an inclusive school and we work hard to make our families feel part of the school and as happy to come here as our pupils.
We are well-staffed with high pupil:staff ratios and are well resourced. Our curriculum is interesting and varied and ensures children know about the world around them.
We are a nurturing school and so our children behave well and feel secure. Our Learning Mentor supports children who need a little extra TLC or intervention and our Family Liaison Officer is always at hand to help parents, carers and families. We even have a school dog who cheers up anyone who meets her!
This website is new and being added to all the time so I hope you find what you need. If you have any questions or would like to look around, then please contact us office@canterbury-road.kent.sch.uk or 01795 423818.
We all look forward to meeting you.

Governors
Our current Chair of Governors is Lindsey Glanville. Lindsey can be contacted via email lglanville@canterbury-road.kent.sch.uk or through a letter handed into the school office.

pageCache.pageTitle: Canterbury Road Primary School - Remote Education
pageCache.text:
Remote Education
Remote Education will only be implemented in emergency situations or government directives. 2020 was a unique situation where remote learning was implemented to ensure all children received an education. We are currently not using remote education as a form of teaching at this time.
Please see our Acceptable Use Policy for our options on Remote Education.
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/providing-remote-education-guidance-for-schools/providing-remote-education-guidance-for-schools
